title_en: The Moment I Hear the Drill
note_en: 一 + verb 1 + 就 + verb 2 means "as soon as…, then…": 一听到电钻声，就浑身发抖 "the moment I hear a dental drill, I shake all over." Here 一 isn't the number one but a marker of "as soon as," and 就 introduces the immediate result. Another: 一喝冰的，牙就疼 "whenever I drink something cold, my tooth hurts."
